title: Trinity Cognitive Probes - THLP Track (MC Format)
subtitle: Hippocampal Learning Probe for AGI Assessment
description:
**Part of the DeepMind AGI Hackathon Submission**

The THLP (Trinity Hippocampal Learning Probe) track in MC format evaluates few-shot learning, belief updating, and error-driven learning through multiple choice questions.

**Contains:**
- 192 MC questions
- Ground truth answers (A/B/C/D)
- Difficulty levels (u03c6-scaled)
- Brain zone metadata (hippocampus, entorhinal cortex)
- Neural analog references

**Evaluation Metrics:**
- Accuracy: Binary correct/incorrect per item
- Calibration: How well model probabilities match actual correctness
- Composite: 60% accuracy + 20% calibration + 20% mean score

**Organization:** gHashTag/trinity
**License:** MIT
